description.narrative: The ASEAN Scholars Leadership Program (ASLP) is an on-award enrichment program available to Aus4ASEAN Scholars that delivers a range of additional learning, networking and development opportunities to support the enrichment of scholar’s experiences in Australia and build people-to-people links. Over 110 Aus4ASEAN Scholars have either participated or have committed to participate in ASLP activities including fortnightly run online ‘leadership connect’ sessions and one of five weekend leadership retreats. ASLP participants are supported to understand that the exercise of developmental leadership is a networked, connected and political process that requires leaders to work strategically together to bring about long-term development change. Australia’s initiatives announced at the 2024 ASEAN-Australia Special Summit, such as the ASLP, were welcomed in the Chairman’s Statement of the 2025 ASEAN Post-Ministerial Conference 10+1 Session.

The ASEAN Scholars Leadership Program (ASLP) is an on-award enrichment program available to Aus4ASEAN Scholars that delivers a range of additional learning, networking and development opportunities. The ASLP helps scholars build their skills, networks and readiness to take on leadership roles and aims to deepen people-to-people links. ‍ The ASLP offers a range of activities throughout the year, including learning and network events such as weekend retreats and a specialised women’s leadership program. Three leadership retreats were completed during the reporting period. Participants in these leadership retreats explored leadership practice, tools and techniques, including emotional intelligence and individual differences, communication and crucial conversations. ‍ The ASLP also supports high performing students to participate in internship programs with Australian businesses in areas that align with students’ respective degrees including humanitarian services, climate change, and mental health.
